issue_name_mr: पिवळा मोझॅक रोग आणि पांढरी माशी
issue_name_hi: पीला मोज़ेक वायरस और सफेद मक्खी
symptoms: Irregular bright yellow and dark green patches on leaves. Stunted vegetative growth and reduced pod filling.
symptoms_mr: पानांवर अनियमित पिवळे आणि हिरवे ठिपके/पट्टे दिसणे. झाडांची वाढ खुंटणे आणि शेंगांमध्ये दाणे न भरणे.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों पर अनियमित पीले और गहरे हरे धब्बे। पौधे का विकास रुक जाना और फलियों में कम दाना भरना।
what_might_be_happening: Soybean Yellow Mosaic Virus (YMV), transmitted by the whitefly insect (Bemisia tabaci). It is not a nutritional deficiency.
immediate_actions: Mark affected plants and ask a local agricultural expert whether removal is appropriate for the suspected problem.
Yellow sticky traps can help monitor whitefly activity; ask a local agricultural expert about suitable placement and density.
Before using any botanical or chemical treatment, confirm the current crop-specific recommendation and label with a qualified local agricultural expert.
Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer which promotes tender succulent leaf growth preferred by whiteflies.
monitoring_points: Check the undersides of leaves for whiteflies and note whether their numbers are increasing.
Observe whether yellowing spreads to nearby plants over the next few days.
escalation_advice: If whiteflies are present or yellowing is spreading, consult your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or Taluka Agriculture Officer. Confirm current local guidance before applying any treatment.

sources.title: ICAR-Indian Institute of Soybean Research Advisory Bulletin

symptoms: Rosette flowers (interlocked petals like a rose), small holes on developing bolls plugged with excreta, stained lint inside opened bolls.
symptoms_mr: गुलाबाच्या कळीसारखी फुले (रोझेट फ्लॉवर), बोंडांना बारीक छिद्रे, बोंड फोडल्यावर आत गुलाबी अळी व खराब झालेला कापूस.
symptoms_hi: गुलाब के फूल जैसी मुड़ी हुई कलियां, गूलर पर बारीक छेद और अंदर गुलाबी रंग की सुंडी का पाया जाना।
what_might_be_happening: Pink Bollworm (Pectinophora gossypiella) larva attacking reproductive squares and green bolls, causing yield reduction and lint staining.
immediate_actions: Pheromone traps can support monitoring; ask a local agricultural expert about the appropriate trap and placement for your area.
Inspect rosette flowers and damaged bolls, and ask a local agricultural expert about safe handling and disposal.
Ask a qualified local agricultural expert whether biological control is suitable for your crop stage and area.
Avoid unverified pesticide use; confirm any product is currently registered for the crop and pest and follow its label.
monitoring_points: Check monitoring traps regularly and record whether moth catches are increasing.
Ask a local agricultural expert how to inspect bolls safely for signs of larvae.
escalation_advice: If rosette flowers or boll damage are observed, consult your Gram Sevak, Agricultural Development Officer (ADO), or nearest KVK for current locally appropriate guidance before treatment.

sources.title: ICAR-Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR) Pest Management Guide
sources.note: National guidelines for Pink Bollworm Management in Bt Cotton

symptoms: Water-soaked small sunken lesions on leaves turning purple with brown concentric rings, leaves breaking from infected zones.
symptoms_mr: पानांवर अंडाकृती जांभळट तपकिरी रंगाचे चट्टे पडणे, चट्टे मोठे होऊन पाने मधूनच वाकणे किंवा जळाल्यासारखी दिसणे.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों पर हल्के भूरे व बैंगनी रंग के धब्बे जो धीरे-धीरे बड़े होकर पत्ती को सुखा देते हैं।
what_might_be_happening: Alternaria porri fungal infection, favored by warm humid weather (80%+ humidity) and cloudy rainy conditions common in Maharashtra.
immediate_actions: Maintain clean field drainage to prevent standing water around the onion bulbs.
Before using a fungicide or additive, confirm current local recommendations, crop registration, and label directions with a qualified agricultural expert.
Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation during cloudy weather; prefer furrow or drip method to minimize leaf wetness.
Rotate crops and avoid continuous planting of allium crops (garlic/onion) on the same plot.
monitoring_points: Inspect central whorl leaves 48 hours after rain or heavy morning dew.
Verify whether lesions are turning dark brown with velvet-like spore growth.
escalation_advice: If disease spreads across more than 15% of vegetative canopy during bulb development stage, consult Taluka Agricultural Officer or KVK Niphad / MPKV Rahuri for registered protective fungicide rotation.

sources.title: ICAR-Directorate of Onion and Garlic Research (DOGR) Crop Protection Manual
sources.note: Maharashtra Kharif and Rangada Onion disease protocols

issue_name_hi: गन्ने का लाल सड़न रोग (रेड रॉट)
symptoms: Third or fourth leaf from top turns yellow and dries from tip along the margins. When stalk is split open, pith shows dull red discoloration with characteristic white cross patches.
symptoms_mr: वरच्या भागातील पाने पिवळी पडून कडेने सुकणे. उसाचे कांड उभे चिरल्यास आतून लाल रंग व पांढरे आडवे पट्टे दिसणे आणि आंबट वास येणे.
symptoms_hi: ऊपरी पत्तियों का सूखना, गन्ने को चीरने पर भीतर लाल रंग और सफेद आड़े धब्बे दिखना व सिरके जैसी गंध आना।
what_might_be_happening: Colletotrichum falcatum fungal pathogen causing systemic vascular destruction in sugarcane canes.
immediate_actions: Mark affected clumps and seek local expert advice on safe removal and disposal; do not burn plant material without checking local rules.
Do not use potentially affected setts for propagation until a local sugarcane expert has assessed them.
Ask a qualified local sugarcane expert about suitable planting-material treatment before planting.
Ensure laser leveling and avoid water stagnation across cane furrows.
monitoring_points: Examine field for patches of sudden drying across rows after water logging.
Check cane rind for shrinkage and longitudinal wrinkles.
escalation_advice: Red rot can devastate cane ratoon crops. Contact your local Sugar Mill Cane Development Department (ऊस विकास अधिकारी) or Vasantdada Sugar Institute (VSI) Pune immediately for variety replacement guidance.

sources.title: Vasantdada Sugar Institute (VSI) Cane Disease Advisory
ICAR-Sugarcane Breeding Institute Extension Guide
sources.note: National red rot disease management protocols

symptoms: Water-soaked oily, dark-brown angular spots on leaves. Characteristic 'L' or 'Y' shaped deep cracks on developing fruits with black oily exudates.
symptoms_mr: पानांवर तेलकट काळे टोकदार ठिपके, फळांवर 'L' किंवा 'Y' आकाराच्या खोल भेगा पडणे आणि तेलकट काळपट डाग तयार होणे.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों और फलों पर तैलीय गहरे काले धब्बे, फलों पर अंग्रेजी के 'L' या 'Y' आकार की दरारें पड़ना।
what_might_be_happening: Xanthomonas axonopodis pv. punicae bacterial infection, spread primarily through rain splashes, pruning shears, and infected saplings.
immediate_actions: Ask a qualified horticulture expert how to prune affected branches and sanitize tools safely.
Collect affected plant material for disposal according to local agricultural and municipal guidance; do not burn it.
Before applying any treatment, confirm the current local recommendation, crop registration, and product label with a qualified horticulture expert.
Never irrigate through overhead micro-sprinklers; use clean underground drip lines.
monitoring_points: Check orchard daily following sudden monsoon rain or high humidity spells.
Observe uninfected fruit skin for minute greasy pin-prick lesions.
escalation_advice: Fruit cracking and oily leaf spots can have multiple causes. Consult ICAR-National Research Centre on Pomegranate (NRCP) Solapur or your district Horticulture Officer for a field assessment and current local guidance.
